calendar.timestamps: Session close in UTC; open and close retained separately
calendar.limitations: Calendar rules are versioned fixtures, not evidence of unscheduled historical exchange closures or observed market prices.

checks: Thanksgiving 2026 is excluded and the following Friday has a 210-minute session ending 18:00 UTC.
The March 2026 DST transition changes the XNYS UTC open from 14:30 to 13:30 and close from 21:00 to 20:00.
Research preflight rejects altered session metadata and labels synthetic prices and volume explicitly.
The dashboard can configure, launch, cancel, review, and select a generated CSV; the selection is tied to its originating asset class and ticker universe.
Data checks are distinguished from model warmup; fixtures with at most 150 bars show a short-history warning.
reviewer: Local automated verification; no broker or market-data certification
